messages:
Amber: Heads up — auth-cache is returning 504s for ~10% of /api/sessions in prod since 10:12 PDT. We have a small patch that pins eviction policy + disables aggressive prefetch. Need expedited approval to push hotfix v1.2.3-hotfix1 to prod. rollback is trivial (revert to v1.2.2). @Matt can you approve?

deploy-bot: Deploy request queued: amber/auth-cache v1.2.3-hotfix1 -> prod. Pre-checks: smoke tests pending, change window: OPEN, approvals required: 1. To approve: `deploy approve 1719801234`

Matt: Can you paste the rollback steps and a short impact assessment? Want to make sure we understand blast radius.

Amber: Rollback plan:
```
# rollback to previous image
kubectl -n prod set image deployment/auth-cache auth-cache=registry.redwood.com/auth-cache:v1.2.2
# watch rollout: kubectl rollout status deployment/auth-cache -n prod
```
Impact: ~30s of connection churn during rollout. No schema changes. Cache warmup ~2m. Smoke on staging passed. Risk: short window of increased session misses but fallback store retains tokens.

Sylvia: infra +1. Looks safe from resource/infra POV. Approving.

Matt: Approved. @deploy-bot please proceed. :shipit:

deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout: 5% -> 50% -> 100% with 2m verification pauses. Watchpoints: 504s on /api/sessions, latency p95.

oncall-bot: Oncall notified. Creating temporary monitor (20m) for session errors and spike alerts.

Dina: Watching logs and SLO dashboards, tailing auth-cache stdout. No new spikes at 5% canary.

deploy-bot: Canary -> 50% complete, pause succeeded. No regressions observed.

Dina: Still clean at 50%. Prometheus shows error rate back to baseline.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: 100% at 10:18 PDT. Post-rollout checks: OK. Marking release as hotfix/expedited.

Amber: Thanks all. I'll add a short note to release notes and pin this version for Dedicated customers who request it. Will also open a follow-up to investigate root cause of cache eviction pattern.

Matt: Good. If we see recurrence we'll schedule a postmortem; otherwise release notes + monitoring ticket is fine.

Sylvia: I'll create the release-notes PR and link the deploy audit.

Amber: cc: @everyone — closing thread once PR is up. :white_check_mark:
